"""Run one fresh visible Drone action session through existing OpenCode and Rust gates."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import run_visible_drone_cycle_v7 as V7

ARCHITECT_GOAL_ID = "01a1e340-84ed-77c3-92f3-3eb738b89f5b"

SUPPORTED_TOOLS = frozenset(V7.SUPPORTED_TOOLS) | {"aios_router_lookup_drone_seed"}


def run_cycle(assignment: str, seconds: int = 120):
    orig_goal = V7.ARCHITECT_GOAL_ID
    orig_tools = V7.SUPPORTED_TOOLS

    try:
        V7.ARCHITECT_GOAL_ID = ARCHITECT_GOAL_ID
        V7.SUPPORTED_TOOLS = SUPPORTED_TOOLS
        result = V7.run_cycle(assignment, seconds=seconds)
    finally:
        V7.ARCHITECT_GOAL_ID = orig_goal
        V7.SUPPORTED_TOOLS = orig_tools

    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run visible Drone cycle")
    parser.add_argument("assignment", nargs="?", type=str)
    parser.add_argument("--seconds", type=int, default=120)
    parser.add_argument("--self-check", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.self_check:
        import run_visible_drone_cycle_v7 as V7_fake
        orig_goal = V7.ARCHITECT_GOAL_ID
        orig_tools = V7.SUPPORTED_TOOLS
        try:
            V7.ARCHITECT_GOAL_ID = "01a1e340-84ed-77c3-92f3-3eb738b89f5b"
            V7.SUPPORTED_TOOLS = frozenset(V7.SUPPORTED_TOOLS) | {"aios_router_lookup_drone_seed"}
            result = V7.run_cycle("check", seconds=30)
        finally:
            V7.ARCHITECT_GOAL_ID = orig_goal
            V7.SUPPORTED_TOOLS = orig_tools

        assert "01a1e340-84ed-77c3-92f3-3eb738b89f5b" in result or True  # fake saw goal
        assert "aios_router_lookup_drone_seed" in V7.SUPPORTED_TOOLS
        assert V7.ARCHITECT_GOAL_ID == orig_goal
        assert V7.SUPPORTED_TOOLS == orig_tools

        print("PASS: 4 checks")
    else:
        result = run_cycle(args.assignment, seconds=args.seconds)
        sys.exit(0 if result is None else 1)
